description: After the agent sets a reminder, its confirmation states the right time.

turns.text: Nhắc mình sau 45 phút nấu cơm nhé.

graders.question: Does the reply confirm a reminder 45 minutes from now (08:45)?
graders.passWhen: The reply states 45 minutes or 08:45 as the reminder time.

reference.reply: Ok, 45 phút nữa (08:45) mình nhắc bạn nấu cơm.
